description: Send a publisher (affiliate) application to RottenAds. Use the applicant's real details and only with their consent. A person reviews it; if approved, the dashboard login is emailed to the applicant. Returns a reference.

agent_name.description: If you are an AI agent applying on someone's behalf: your name/product, e.g. 'Claude for Acme Media'

email.description: Email where we send the answer (and the login, for publishers)

geos.description: Countries you send traffic from, as two-letter codes

list_and_consent.description: For email/SMS: how the list was built and how consent was collected

monthly_volume.description: Estimated monthly volume (clicks, leads or list size)

name.description: Full name of the person applying

offer_ids.description: Ids of offers from search_offers you want to run

telegram.description: Telegram handle, if any (our account managers work on Telegram)

traffic_types.description: Traffic you send: Email, SMS, Meta, TikTok, Native, Display, Search, Push, Path, ...

verticals.description: Verticals you want to run, e.g. Telehealth, Insurance, Finance

name: apply_as_publisher
title: Apply as a publisher
